title: The wind has picked up
principle: How an outlook guides imagined additions

alt.optimism: The unchanged person and line become a kite flyer on an open hill, with a patterned kite, ribbon tail, birds, grass, flowers and picnic basket.
alt.pessimism: The unchanged person holds a rope attached to a strained campsite shelter. Dark cloud outlines, slanting rain, loose fabric and scattered objects illustrate an imagined worry.
alt.curiosity: The unchanged person holds a windsock tether beside a homemade weather station, three test ribbons and an open field notebook. The scene invites observation rather than predicting an outcome.
